title: Stock up on Maxwell House K-Cups on Amazon — 168 pods for just 39 cents each
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Stock up on Maxwell House K-Cups on Amazon — 168 pods for just 39 cents each

This House Blend medium roast has more than 30,000 Amazon reviews and a 4.7-star rating, making the $65.49 two-pack worth a look.

Enjoy fresh, hot coffee at home for less. (iStock)

Coffee costs can add up, but this Maxwell House K-Cup deal makes it easier to save. The two-pack includes 168 House Blend medium-roast pods and has dropped from $80 to $65 — just about 39 cents per pod.

This two-pack of coffee pods comes highly reviewed on Amazon. (Amazon)

Buying in bulk can help lower the cost of your daily coffee, and this two-pack brings each pod to about 39 cents. The 168 medium-roast Maxwell House pods have more than 30,000 Amazon reviews and a 4.7-star rating, making them a popular pick for budget-conscious coffee drinkers.

Made with 100% Arabica coffee, the House Blend offers a rich aroma and full-bodied flavor. The pods work with Keurig coffee makers, so you can brew a cup whenever you need it.

READ MORE: Amazon just dropped this $190 Keurig coffee maker to $100 — one of its lowest prices ever

More than 30,000 Amazon reviews praise the Maxwell House K-Cup's rich flavor, affordability and convenience.

One reviewer wrote: "This is the best bang for your buck! It's cheaper than the food store 95% of the time, and it's great for those who drink a lot of coffee. The flavor is always fresh."

"This coffee has become a dependable part of my daily routine. The medium roast strikes a nice balance, not too strong and not too mild, with a smooth flavor that's easy to enjoy," wrote another.

Another reviewer praised the convenience: "These K-Cups are some of my favorites. They taste great, are convenient and are compatible with Keurig machines. They are just right; very flavorful and not too bitter."

For more deals, visit www.foxnews.com/deals

The main drawback shoppers noted is that grounds can end up in the bottom of the coffee cup. You'll need to make sure your machine is cleaned properly before inserting pods, which can help mitigate this annoyance.

It's a fair trade-off, however, when you consider the price per pod. At $65, it's a solid choice for anyone who wants to save on their daily coffee fix and go for an affordable bulk option.
